comparison.objective: Fully unfold a passive laptop stand and seat both support rods in its highest slots inside a marked area.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinate a scissor linkage and insert two support rods into separate detents.
comparison.success_condition: Independent credit covers full spread and each rod; full credit additionally requires both rails supported, outline inside the rectangle, and release.
comparison.reason: This is articulated unfolding and dual rod seating; it has no threaded adjustment, coupled locknut reaction, or repeated-motion retention test. The rubric does not numerically define “full spread” or gripper-clear distance, but that omission does not create plausible overlap.
